rule: No live TrustLoop review text is ever used for training. Inference text is processed transiently and never retained. Raw datasets stay outside version control; this manifest records sources, licences, verification status, and hashes when files are acquired.

verificationStates.verified: licence terms read and recorded from the distribution point during Phase 0
verificationStates.on-request: distribution requires contacting the author; terms confirmed in writing before first use
verificationStates.pending: candidate listed; terms or rights basis are unresolved; do not acquire or use
verificationStates.planned: future collection not yet performed; no files or hashes exist

pipeline.normalization: Unicode NFKC; collapse all whitespace to one ASCII space; preserve case; no stemming

nearDuplicate.action: drop duplicate rows before splitting; conflicting labels fail for manual review

pipeline.grouping: group by source_id, language, and product_id (or page_id when product_id is empty); groups never cross splits
pipeline.calibrationRule: calibration split is held out from hyperparameter tuning; held-out manual evaluation sources remain separate and are never admitted to training splits
pipeline.splitCounts: generated in data/processed/splits/split-manifest.json after hash-pinned inputs are acquired

sources.name: Deceptive Opinion Spam Corpus (Ott et al., 2011)
sources.labelBasis: crowdsourced deceptive vs truthful hotel reviews
sources.distributionPoint: Kaggle mirror by Rachael Tatman (rtatman/deceptive-opinion-spam-corpus); canonical copy by the authors
sources.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (Kaggle mirror; non-commercial, share-alike, attribution)
sources.verificationNote: Terms read from the Kaggle dataset page on 2026-10-30. Non-commercial use covers coursework; data is not redistributed, so share-alike is not triggered. Attribute Ott, Cardie, Hancock (2011).
sources.redistribution: forbidden by project rule; raw files stay out of version control

sources.name: Negative Deceptive Opinion Spam (Ott et al., 2013)
sources.role: blocked training-dev candidate; verify terms before acquisition
sources.labelBasis: crowdsourced negative deceptive vs truthful hotel reviews
sources.distributionPoint: Stanford Social Media Lab page for the 2013 corpus
sources.license: research use, distributed by the authors; terms to be recorded at download
sources.verificationNote: Must be confirmed from the distribution page at download time and recorded here before training uses it.

sources.name: YelpChi (Rayana & Akoglu, 2015)
sources.role: optional cross-domain evaluation only; never training
sources.license: no licence stated at the distribution page
sources.verificationNote: Distribution page states no terms; written confirmation of research-use terms required from the maintainer before any use. Filter labels are a platform signal, not ground truth; text-only evaluation; metadata leakage risk documented in model plan section 4.
sources.reviewerData: not collected; metadata columns are dropped unread
sources.labelMapping: not used as a label (codebook section 7)

sources.name: Amazon review dataset distributed with GraphConsis (Dou et al., 2020)
sources.distributionPoint: project repository of Dou et al.
sources.verificationNote: Model plan flags: confirm whether labels are review-level or reviewer-level; reviewer-level labels must never become review labels; confirm licence. Unused until verified.
sources.reviewerData: reviewer-level columns excluded if ever used
sources.labelMapping: review-level fake -> manipulated proxy only if verified (codebook section 7)

sources.name: In-domain manual held-out sample, English
sources.license: project-internal; evaluation-only; never used for training
sources.verificationNote: Collection has not occurred. The v1.1 sampling method and annotation protocol are pre-registered. Review text, page URLs, and annotation rationales are never committed.
sources.reviewerData: never collected: no names, avatars, ratings, or profile links recorded

sources.name: In-domain manual held-out sample, French
sources.role: primary held-out evaluation (gate), French go/no-go input (D23)
sources.license: project-internal; evaluation-only; never used for training
sources.verificationNote: Collection has not occurred. The v1.1 sampling method and annotation protocol are pre-registered. French evaluation uses manual labels only; translated training data is augmentation and never evaluation input.

augmentation.role: training augmentation only, if needed for FR
augmentation.rule: Local or licensed translation tool only; documented processing note in the model card; FR evaluation still uses manual labels only (model plan section 4).

hashPolicy: At acquisition time each dataset file's SHA-256 is recorded in its source entry's files[] as {path, sha256, bytes}; files[] stays empty until acquisition. The Phase 1 pipeline fails if a listed file is absent or its hash/byte count differs. A verified licence/source may have no files before acquisition; use verification=planned for manual samples not yet collected. Never create placeholder hashes.
splitPolicy: Split by product/page and by source, not by individual review. Near-duplicates removed across splits before training. Train / dev / calibration / test; calibration split never used for hyperparameter tuning. Random seeds recorded (model plan section 7).
